correctness.rationale: The 19 quadratic-residue facets give 8,247 faces including empty and 40,033 covering incidences. The full priority matching has 4,081 matched pairs and an exact topological-sort acyclicity check. On nonempty faces this yields CW critical cells in dimensions 0,2,3 with counts 1,4,81. Signed gradient-path elimination computes the complete integral \(4\times81\) Morse differential; every column obeys row relation (1,-2,-1,1), forcing rank at most three, while rows (0,1,2), columns (0,1,4) have determinant -1, forcing rank three and a primitive image. Therefore reduced integral homology is \(\widetilde H_2\cong\mathbb Z\), \(\widetilde H_3\cong\mathbb Z^{78}\). A 0,2,3-dimensional CW model has simply connected two-skeleton wedge of four 2-spheres; attaching maps of three-cells are precisely elements of \(\pi_2\cong\mathbb Z^4\), classified by the integral boundary. Smith equivalence yields \(S^2\vee\bigvee^{78}S^3\). Separate reversed priority matching gives 6 two-cells,83 three-cells, independently rank5 over Q. All checks are implemented in enclosed standalone verify.py.

value.rationale: Directed out-neighborhood complexes are a foundational functor of directed graphs, and this is a complete homotopy classification for the canonical quadratic-residue tournament of order 19, a natural larger case beyond the recorded Paley-11 computation. The mixed two-degree wedge \(S^2\vee\bigvee^{78}S^3\) contains exact integral attaching-map information stronger than rational Betti or Euler characteristics. The specific object and invariant are mathematically motivated and reproducible, not an arbitrary slice; neither a general family theorem nor independent audit is claimed.
